messages.subject: Meridian – new master agreement with Harcourt Beverages
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi Sarah,

Good to catch up earlier. As discussed, we've agreed commercial heads with Harcourt Beverages for a three-year subscription to our Cadence platform (their 32 UK sites). They want their lawyers Marlowe Greaves involved, so we'd like you to lead on the contract from our side.

Can you send an engagement letter and get a first MSSA draft to them? Target annual fee is £840k plus a £120k implementation.

Thanks,
Henry

Henry Calderwood | CFO | Meridian Signal Analytics

messages.subject: RE: Meridian – new master agreement with Harcourt Beverages
messages.plaintextBody:
Henry,

Delighted to help. Engagement letter attached for signature – fee estimate £28–38k plus VAT for a single principal round of negotiation. James Osei and Elena Marchetti will work with me.

We'll prepare a supplier-friendly first draft MSSA with the Order Form, SOW, SLA and a UK GDPR DPA, and aim to get it to Marlowe Greaves next week. The two points to think about up front are the liability cap and how we treat data-protection breaches – I'll flag our recommended positions in the draft.

Best,
Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
